Currently, all avatars in the instance are automatically loaded order by distance or priority settings.

But some avatars doesn't need to load because it's in places that room is partioned such as ,  and it's wastage of bandwidth and processing .

So I request to add Avatar loadable field that if the avatar will load when players in same field of collider.

This feature includes security advantage to save some users who outside the avatar load area from broken or malicious avatars that affects crash clients as a secondary effect.

Currently, all avatars in an instance are loaded automatically based on distance or priority settings.

However, some avatars don't need to load if the world is divided into rooms such as [ひまり旅館](https://vrchat.com/home/world/wrld_d619675d-139d-4e58-bcda-da26a3c75c0e),  and it will be a waste of bandwidth and processing power.

Therefore, I would like to request the addition of a feature whereby avatars load or unload depending on whether players are in the same  collider bounds.

As a secondary benefit, this feature has a security advantage in that it protects users who are outside the avatar load area from broken or malicious avatars which crash clients.
title: Avatar loadable area.
